notes.title: Update 14_11_24
notes.content:
_The seller's store system 'Seibe' has been changed and improved.
_The equipment system has been improved, it is now possible to equip parts separately from weapons.
_New pet system it is now possible to equip the pet of your choice.
_Added a new pet ''SCROPER''. Complete a mission to get it.
_The main character's animations have been improved.
_Fixed some bugs.
_Added new enemies.
_Added a new house system, now the houses have interactive doors and drawers.
_All weapons have been remodeled from scratch.
_Added some textures to some objects.
_Several items were modeled from scratch.
_New icon images have been changed.
_Hud inventory has been improved.

notes.title: Update 16_01_2024
notes.content:
_Fixed some bugs.
_New types of grenades have been added.
_Some game objects have been remodeled.
_Added new animations to the main character.
_The melee combat system has been improved.
_Added new function to melee weapons, now it is possible to throw them.
_Melee weapon ''Rox Dagger'' has been added to the game.
_Some changes were made to the scenario.
_Added giant chests to the game, using a key you can open and obtain a weapon.
_Reward for defeating an enemy has been changed, now a small box with random items will appear.

notes.title: Update 09_01_2024
notes.content:
_Fixed some bugs.
_Added Enemy E_books: It is now possible to know information about enemies: Damage they cause, amount of life they have, etc...
_Added E_book for some weapons to the game: It is now possible to find out information about the weapons.
_And I need to go to a merchant to get access to the E_books.
